conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met with a payload lipid in place of the silicone. Prominent cationic Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @6; prominent waxy payload lipid Hydrogenated Castor Oil @9; pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @12; listed humectant Panthenol @7; plus refatters Glyceryl Oleate @11, PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @15.
